peak.definition: The top or extreme point of something (usually a mountain or hill).

summit.definition: The top or extreme point of something (usually a mountain or hill).

ridge.definition: To spade into alternate ridges and troughs.

cliff.definition: A steep wall of rock or earth.

valley.definition: Low land between hills or mountains.

boulder.definition: A town in north central Colorado.

ledge.definition: A projecting ridge on a mountain or submerged under water.

pine-tree.definition: A tall evergreen tree with thin needle-like leaves.

wildflower.definition: A wild flower that grows without being planted.

fern.definition: A plant with soft green leaves and no flowers.

lichen.definition: Any thallophytic plant of the division Lichenes.

shrub.definition: A low woody perennial plant usually having several major stems.

alpine-meadow.definition: A high-elevation grassland found above or near the tree line in mountain regions.

tree-line.definition: The boundary above which trees cannot grow in mountain regions or at very high northern latitudes.

root.definition: The part of a plant that grows underground and takes in water.

bark.definition: The rough outer covering of a tree trunk.

mountain-goat.definition: A sure-footed hoofed mammal of North American mountains with a white coat and short black horns.
mountain-goat.exampleUsage: A mountain goat stood on a rocky slope.

deer.definition: Distinguished from Bovidae by the male's having solid deciduous antlers.

marmot.definition: Stocky coarse-furred burrowing rodent with a short bushy tail found throughout the Northern Hemisphere.

hawk.definition: Diurnal bird of prey typically having short rounded wings and a long tail.
hawk.exampleUsage: The hawk was identified during the lesson.

owl.definition: Nocturnal bird of prey with hawk-like beak and claws and large head with front-facing eyes.
owl.exampleUsage: The owl was identified during the lesson.

fox.definition: A member of an Algonquian people formerly living west of Lake Michigan along the Fox River.

mountain-lion.definition: A large wild cat native to the Americas, also called a cougar or puma.
mountain-lion.exampleUsage: A wildlife sign explained that mountain lions live in the region.

snow.definition: Frozen water that falls from clouds as soft white flakes.

fog.definition: A thick cloud near the ground that makes it difficult to see.

wind.definition: Air moving (sometimes with considerable force) from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure.

cloud.definition: To make less visible or unclear.

lightning.definition: A bright flash of electricity in the sky.

sunrise.definition: The time when the sun first appears in the sky.

sunset.definition: Of a declining industry or technology.

rainbow.definition: A curved band of colours seen when sunlight shines through rain.

frost.definition: A thin layer of ice that forms on surfaces in cold weather.

hail.definition: Small balls of ice that fall from clouds during a storm.

hiking-boots.definition: Strong shoes designed for walking on rough ground.

trekking-pole.definition: A hand-held pole used by hikers to support balance while walking on trails.
trekking-pole.exampleUsage: The hiker carried trekking poles on the marked trail.

water-bottle.definition: A container used for carrying drinking water.

compass.definition: An area in which something acts or operates or has power or control:.

map.definition: A drawing that shows places, routes, and geographical features.

headlamp.definition: A light worn on the head so both hands remain free.

tent.definition: A temporary shelter made from fabric and supported by poles.

sleeping-bag.definition: A warm padded bag used for sleeping outdoors.

rope.definition: A strong cord used for tying or securing things.

hiking.definition: Walking for a long distance in the countryside.

climbing.definition: Moving up or over something using hands and feet.

camping.definition: The act of encamping and living in tents in a camp.

skiing.definition: A sport in which participants must travel on skis.

snowboarding.definition: The act of sliding down a snow-covered slope while standing on a snowboard.

bird-watching.definition: Watching birds to identify and enjoy them.
bird-watching.exampleUsage: The bird watching was identified during the lesson.

fishing.definition: Catching fish as a sport or activity.
fishing.exampleUsage: The fishing was identified during the lesson.

trail-running.definition: Running on outdoor paths or trails rather than mainly on paved roads or tracks.
trail-running.exampleUsage: The event organizes trail running on marked routes with safety support.
